summary.text: Unrestrained Heavenly Mark is an immortal killer move that refines heaven path dao marks.

claims.text: Fang Yuan is deep inside Dragon Palace, obstructed by heaven path dao marks. Heaven-human sensation and human executing heaven’s work mix his will with heaven’s will so he can sense those dao marks. He then activates unrestrained heavenly mark, expends rank eight immortal essence rapidly, and quickly refines three heaven path dao marks. Heaven’s will is infuriated. The dao marks gather from their scattered places and, in a few breaths, a myriad tribulation forms. He considers whether forcefully refining heaven path dao marks angers the Heavenly Dao, or whether this killer move has a problem.

To refine heaven path dao marks he has to mingle with heaven’s will and use both heaven-human sensation and human executing heaven’s work to capture their location, then use unrestrained heavenly mark to refine them. Heaven’s will is necessary for that process. If he used heaven’s will dissipation and got rid of heaven’s will, he would also be unable to refine those dao marks.
Lu Wei Yin knew about Fang Yuan’s tribulation. The heavenly mark killer move Fang Yuan had was given to him by Lu Wei Yin.

Fang Yuan is confident he can create new dream path killer moves even with ordinary dream path attainment, because he has unrestrained heavenly mark and can create a large number of compound killer moves.
Lingering poisonous ant plague expended unrestrained heavenly marks.

Old Eccentric Tian Nan could not refine heaven path dao marks. Limitless Demon Venerable succeeded in heaven path refinement. Over a million years later, Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable obtained Limitless Demon Venerable’s method in Crazed Demon Cave. That method is unrestrained heavenly mark. The killer move Lu Wei Yin gave Fang Yuan was not created by Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable. Paradise Earth merely modified it. The source was Limitless.

Fang Yuan’s unrestrained heavenly marks had already passed ten thousand. Every grotto-heaven he annexed provided heaven path dao marks to the sovereign immortal aperture, which he refined into unrestrained heavenly marks. He attributes partial refinement and activation of heaven’s envy Immortal Gu to those marks.

As long as the unrestrained heavenly marks reach a certain number, heaven path Immortal Gu can be refined. Unrestrained heavenly mark is the key to starting heaven path cultivation. Among all the paths, heaven path has the highest starting threshold: one must grasp this killer move first. Limitless Demon Venerable and Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable might have grasp of it, but from what Fang Yuan knew they had not delved deeply into heaven path.
